title: The home page answers what to do now: drafts ready, decisions waiting, the open region's progress and each flow's state, problems first
description: The home page (/, the Console) is a build tracker: lanes, every change in flight, rows landed, rows watching, integrity and a run outcomes donut. The Owner opens it to learn what to do next and has to read it all to find out. Make it a Today summary that answers that in about five seconds. First any problem (fwd unreachable, kill switch, budget pause or breaker). Then a Today block: how many drafts are ready to send across the flows (from each flow's drafts) and how many decisions are waiting (open cards), each a link to where the Owner acts on them; the open region's progress toward each of its targets, from GET /v1/flows/neighborhood-activation; and each flow from GET /v1/supervisor with its state word (Running, Ready, Held) and, when held, its one reason. Today's digest headline stays as one line. Anything fwd did not answer reads Unknown, never zero. Move the build-tracker sections into an exported dawn/BuildOverview.tsx so another page can mount it. api.dawn() keeps its shape.
acceptance: The home page shows the number of drafts ready to send and of decisions waiting, each as a link to where they are worked
The home page shows the open region's name and each of its measures as a value of its target, and Unknown when fwd has no measures
The home page lists every flow with Running, Ready or Held and, when held, its reason
With the kill switch engaged or the budget pause on, the problem shows before the Today summary
With fwd unreachable the page says so and the counts read Unknown, not zero
The build-tracker sections are not on the home page; dawn/BuildOverview.tsx exports BuildOverview, which shows them; the digest headline shows once
